title: [Bug]: New loopback_ip var in test_acl.py not populated correctly if rand_selected_dut is supervisor on T2
author: Javier-Tan
body:
### Issue Description
Loopback IP variable (introduced in #15619) in `test_acl.py` doesn't get populated properly when supervisor is chosen through `rand_selected_dut` as supervisor doesn't have a loopback ip in mg_facts. This causes errors when applying `loopback_ip` to .j2 templates.

**Additionally we know this to not happen if a LC is chosen**

### Results you see
loopback_ip is not populated when a supervisor is chosen
```
conftest.set_rand_one_dut_hostname       L0499 INFO   | Randomly select dut sonic1-sup for testing
...
test_acl.acl_table                       L0595 INFO   | Generated ACL table configuration:
{'loopback_ip': None,
 ...}
```

This causes failures when trying to apply `loopback_ip` to .j2 templates

```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.11/dist-packages/openconfig_acl.py", line 1662, in _set_destination_ip_address
    t = YANGDynClass(v,base=[RestrictedClassType(base_type=six.text_type, restriction_dict={u'pattern': u'(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9][0-9]|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9][0-9]|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/(([0-9])|([1-2][0-9])|(3[0-2]))'}),RestrictedClassType(base_type=six.text_type, restriction_dict={u'pattern': u'((:|[0-9a-fA-F]{0,4}):)([0-9a-fA-F]{0,4}:){0,5}((([0-9a-fA-F]{0,4}:)?(:|[0-9a-fA-F]{0,4}))|(((25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9]?[0-9])\\.){3}(25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|[01]?[0-9]?[0-9])))(/(([0-9])|([0-9]{2})|(1[0-1][0-9])|(12[0-8])))'}),], is_leaf=True, yang_name="destination-ip-address", parent=self, path_helper=self._path_helper, extmethods=self._extmethods, register_paths=True, namespace='http://openconfig.net/yang/acl', defining_module='openconfig-acl', yang_type='inet:ip-prefix', is_config=True)
        ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.11/dist-packages/pyangbind/lib/yangtypes.py", line 978, in YANGDynClass
    raise TypeError("did not find a valid type using the argument as a" + " hint")
TypeError: did not find a valid type using the argument as a hint
```

### Results you expected to see
Supervisor shouldn't be chosen as random DUT if loopback ip is needed OR loopback ip should have a default

### Is it platform specific
generic

### Output of `show version`

_No response_
